description: This file implements the LifecycleManager class, handling application lifecycle events, notifications, and interactions with runtime and window managers within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements application lifecycle management, event dispatching, and notification handling within the plugin.

classes.name: ApplicationContext
classes.description: Holds application-specific state and parameters, used internally for managing app lifecycle.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the lifecycle manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event asynchronously to registered listeners.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events and notifies registered callbacks.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently loaded applications.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an app with the given ID is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launches a new application instance asynchronously.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Changes the state of a loaded application.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Gracefully unloads an application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully terminates an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends a navigation intent to an active application.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Signals that an app is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application based on the specified reason.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the application context for a given app instance ID or app ID.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events (currently commented out).

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events.

methods.name: handleRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes runtime manager events such as termination, state changes, failures, and start events.

methods.name: notifyOnFailure
methods.description: Dispatches failure notifications for applications.

methods.name: handleStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles application state change events, including cleanup of unloaded apps.

methods.name: handleWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes window manager events like user inactivity, disconnect, and readiness.

methods.name: addStateTransitionRequest
methods.description: Adds a request to transition an application's state based on events.
